Selection guide

How to choose gaming vendors

Gaming vendor selection is different from normal software outsourcing. The right partner must understand gameplay, retention, economy design and technical delivery.

Should a Web3 game hire a game studio or an infrastructure provider first?

If the game design is not clear, start with a game studio or product design partner. If the gameplay is already defined, then infrastructure providers can help with wallets, NFT assets, marketplace rails, data, security and live operations.

What makes Web3 gaming vendors different from normal game vendors?

Web3 gaming vendors usually understand wallet onboarding, NFT or digital asset ownership, marketplace behavior, player custody, smart contracts, token incentives and community-led distribution. Strong teams also know when not to add Web3 complexity.

What should companies check before building a Web3 game?

Check the gameplay loop, target player, wallet experience, asset model, compliance assumptions, smart contract security, content pipeline, retention plan and whether blockchain improves the game rather than distracting from it.
